decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Doomsday to set up a winning combination where Thassa's Oracle is the key piece to secure victory. It includes various card draw and manipulation spells to help assemble the combo quickly, along with disruption spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo from opposing interaction. The deck also includes powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain further advantage and accelerate the game plan. It aims to win the game quickly and efficiently through the use of its combo pieces and efficient card selection.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also maintaining card advantage and board presence. It capitalizes on efficient creature removal, card draw, and graveyard hate to control the game tempo. The inclusion of a companion adds an additional strategic element to the deck. It aims to out-value the opponent through incremental advantages and resource management, ultimately establishing dominance and securing victory through attrition and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying fast and aggressive pressure. By playing hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper and Archon of Emeria, it slows down the opponent's strategy, while cards like Cavern of Souls and Chancellor of the Annex protect key creatures from counterspells. With mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and Moxen, this deck aims to establish board control quickly and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine further hinders the opponent's ability to develop their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to combo off and generate infinite mana with powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Brain Freeze, and Brainstorm. The deck also includes a variety of fast mana sources like Black Lotus, Moxen, and Mana Crypt to quickly ramp up and establish a dominant board presence. The inclusion of disruption spells like Force of Will, Pyroblast, and Flusterstorm helps protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. With Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck can consistently recur key cards and maintain its aggressive tempo.

The deck relies on generating a high amount of mana and casting multiple spells in a single turn to build up a storm count. The key strategy is to assemble the pieces needed to use cards like Tendrils of Agony to drain the opponent's life total in one big burst. By utilizing powerful mana sources like Black Lotus and Moxen, along with efficient card draw and tutoring spells, the deck aims to quickly execute its combo and win the game before the opponent can respond.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with Dredge cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Thug to constantly bring back creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam. Using Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to manipulate the hand, the deck aims to create explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent with an army of recurring creatures. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Chalice of the Void helps protect the combo and disrupt opponents' game plans while also enabling powerful graveyard recursion synergies.

The deck relies on using mana denial tactics such as Wasteland, Ghost Quarter, and Sphere of Resistance to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly establishing a board presence with powerful colorless threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Stonecoil Serpent. It also utilizes artifacts like Nettlecyst and Mystic Forge to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. Additionally, it has access to powerful sideboard options like Karn, the Great Creator and Trinisphere to further control the game. Overall, the deck aims to overpower opponents with efficient threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive hatebears that disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex, while also utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude for removal. The deck aims to control the board with efficient creatures and disruptive elements, while also using efficient mana acceleration like Black Lotus and Moxen to power out threats quickly. The deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive strategy, with Cavern of Souls and Ancient Tomb helping to cast its powerful creatures ahead of schedule.

The focus of this Dredge combo deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Golgari Thug, and Stinkweed Imp, allowing for powerful graveyard interactions with cards like Narcomoeba, Prized Amalgam, and Creeping Chill. Utilizing key spells like Serum Powder and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flood of creatures from the graveyard and powerful spells to quickly win the game.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and mana acceleration to quickly generate a large amount of mana, allowing the player to cast powerful spells and combo off with cards like Paradoxical Outcome. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional recursion for cheap artifacts, while cards like Sol Ring and Black Lotus enable explosive starts. With a mix of control elements like Force of Will and card draw/selection like Ancestral Recall and Gitaxian Probe, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and versatile game plan.

The control deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Bolas's Citadel. The deck also includes various counterspells to protect against opposing threats, as well as ramp cards like Black Lotus and Sol Ring to accelerate mana production. The inclusion of cards like Show and Tell and Tinker allows for additional ways to cheat out game-winning threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently controlling the game while setting up powerful combo plays with Oath of Druids.

The deck focuses on quickly playing disruptive artifacts like Sphere of Resistance, Chalice of the Void, and Nettlecyst to slow down the opponent's plays while building up resources with cards like Crucible of Worlds and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Stonecoil Serpent and Scrawling Crawler while using cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge for additional advantage. The deck also makes use of powerful lands like Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy to generate mana and stay ahead in the game.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures quickly to disrupt the opponent's game plan while still being aggressive with efficient threats. It utilizes cards such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to slow down the opponent's spells, while Anointed Peacekeeper and Chancellor of the Annex prevent attacks. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration like Black Lotus and Moxen to power out its threats early on. This deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their strategy, making it a challenging opponent to deal with in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using fast mana acceleration and card draw to assemble the pieces needed for a powerful combo turn. The goal is to generate a high storm count through spells like Dark Ritual and Stock Up, eventually winning the game with Tendrils of Agony. The deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and interaction with artifacts like Bolas's Citadel and Karn, the Great Creator. The inclusion of tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor helps find key combo pieces quickly, while powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk provide additional card advantage and tempo advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact mana ramp and card draw to quickly play out threats like Grim Monolith and Glaring Fleshraker. Manifold Key and Nettlecyst provide additional synergy with artifacts, while Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opposing artifact strategies. The inclusion of cards like Mystic Forge and Sensei's Divining Top help ensure a consistent stream of threats and answers. The deck is capable of explosive plays and overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and artifact synergy.

The deck revolves around utilizing the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach to continuously recur key spells from the graveyard, generate infinite mana, and eventually win the game through a storm or mill win condition. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion and value. The deck aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells and removal while assembling its combo pieces, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of spells and powerful game-ending plays.
